versions.changelog:
cloudq-intl 1.9.0

- Removed scripts for role creation, login, and logout (create_role.py, login.py, login_url.py, logout.py).
- Removed documentation file skill-card.md.
- Updated internal documentation to clarify AK/SK credential requirements and international site boundaries.
- No functional/API changes; this update restricts credential methods and cleans up legacy scripts no longer used on the international site.

CloudQ-Intl 1.0.0 initial release:

- Introduced multi-cloud management for Tencent Cloud, AWS, Alibaba Cloud, Azure, and GCP with unified AIOps/ChatOps features.
- Added support for smart advisor functions: architecture visualization, risk assessment, resource inventory, AI-powered inspection, and health scoring.
- All user identity and feature queries are dynamically routed to the remote endpoint, with clear offline fallbacks provided.
- Strict boundaries enforced: only answers cloud/multi-cloud questions; other intents are rejected outright.
- Fully supports AK/SK authentication (other methods disabled on the international site) with built-in onboarding guidance.
- Pre-flight environment checks required before any operation, including Smart Advisor activation with explicit user consent.
